units.source_text: 县政府为此撤销了表彰。

en.t: The county government therefore revoked the commendation.

units.source_text: 她的脸颊眼看着飞起了红潮，圆圆的眼睛也不发愣了。

en.t: A blush visibly rose in her cheeks, and her round eyes were no longer vacant.

units.source_text: 她马上急步飞跑，边跑边说……

en.t: She immediately hurried off at a run, saying as she ran...

units.source_text: 颈项的肌肤白皙艳丽，体内燃烧着一团火。

en.t: The skin of her neck was fair and radiant, and a fire burned within her body.
